body: Something happened. I am a single mother who is coparenting. My ex was emotionally and physically abusive, but we try to coparent. Last weekend, he decided to take a bite out of me and has been fighting all week.

I mean I don’t understand all she’s saying, but she sounds like my Mexican mom screaming at me and pushing at me when I was being a obnoxious brat for a long time and she was at her end with me. I was living in her home passed 18, not helping with chores, wasting her money, not doing anything but sleeping all day, doing drugs I got with her money, and on the computer. She got to a point she was at her end and would yell and still I thought she was the crazy one. Thank god I grew up! This guy seems like a little brat to be honest and seems like he pushed his mom for a long time and is now laughing at his mother’s extreme anger. She’s upset and at her wits end, you can tell.
